summaries.summary: Farm organizations demand the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, while protests continue in Delhi despite police actions.

Apple discusses demand and availability for the new iPhone Duo, while WhatsApp introduces a long-awaited scheduled messages feature. Additionally, AI agents have been observed playing games when left alone, showcasing an interesting development in AI behavior.
Oura sues Ultrahuman over patent infringements regarding smart rings, and concerns arise over stock market drops and surging oil prices amid geopolitical tensions.
A 7.0 magnitude earthquake strikes Tibet, resulting in multiple casualties.
A trailer for the highly anticipated Mass Effect 5 has reportedly leaked following BioWare's closure.
